scholarships.title: GETFund Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship (Ghana Education Trust Fund)

existing.description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund's postgraduate foreign scholarship supports Ghanaians studying at postgraduate level outside Ghana, with financial support covering tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials. GETFund describes its programme as financial, social and academic support with priority given to STEM programmes and to female education, and it also funds capacity building, faculty development through the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission and short courses abroad. Applications for the 2026/2027 postgraduate foreign scholarships opened on 13 April 2026 and closed on 30 April 2026, so the next round is expected in the first half of 2027.
eligibility: Be a Ghanaian national applying for postgraduate study
Study outside Ghana under the foreign scholarship category
Meet the academic requirements of the postgraduate programme applied for
Fall within GETFund's priority areas, which give weight to STEM programmes and to female education
existing.eligibility_summary: Ghanaian applicants at postgraduate level seeking to study outside Ghana under the GETFund scholarship programme, which is aimed at brilliant but needy candidates and gives priority to STEM and to women.
benefits: Tuition fee support for the postgraduate programme abroad
Social and academic support alongside the financial award
requirements: Apply within the annual GETFund application window
Use the GETFund scholarship portal to submit the application
Accept the academic and reporting requirements that GETFund applies to its scholars
documents: Completed GETFund scholarship application submitted through the GETFund portal
Academic records required by GETFund for the scholarship category
Documents confirming the admission or programme place abroad
existing.english_requirement: Not published on the pages read
application_method: Watch the GETFund news and scholarship pages for the opening of the annual window
Register on the GETFund scholarship portal and complete the foreign scholarship application
Submit supporting academic and admission documents by the published closing date
existing.selection_notes: GETFund states that the programme expands beyond the traditional brilliant but needy requirement and covers support at undergraduate and postgraduate level, capacity building in public institutions and agencies, faculty development through the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission for university lecturers pursuing further education abroad, funding for short courses abroad, and support for students competing in international educational competitive programmes. Published programme statistics are 1,586 undergraduate scholars, 3,448 masters scholars and 487 PhD scholars, alongside 697 executive education programmes.
existing.best_fit: Ghanaian postgraduate students who need to fund study outside Ghana, particularly women and applicants in STEM fields.
existing.notes: The awarding body's own programme overview states that financial support includes tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials, and it does not publish a stipend figure, so no amount is asserted and the award is recorded as partially rather than fully funded.
existing.duration: Duration of the postgraduate programme abroad
existing.application_period: Annual call, with the 2026/2027 window running from 13 April to 30 April 2026
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026/2027 postgraduate foreign scholarships opened on 13 April 2026 and closed on 30 April 2026; the call is issued annually, so the next round is expected in the first half of 2027
